title: SID MEDICOS hosts appreciation ceremony for LemonBottle partners from the Philippines
summary: Approximately 10 distributor representatives and aesthetics professionals visited the company’s headquarters on November 17: new product briefing and cultural activities deepen brand understanding and strengthen partner relationships
